findings.blocking_worker_to_core_exit_4: fixed. core_poller_hold now holds Core only on a move to the worker (wanted worker and running worker gives worker; everything else gives core). A worker -> core switch recreates Core with core at step 7. abandon_idle, when it keeps the new colour and the wanted value is core, also runs release_core_poller. report_poller_on_exit states Core's own value and the ChatInbox rule for worker colours, and names the registered colour after register. Test: the review's case (HOLD=worker, WANTED=core, register 4, removable 4) now records 'up -d --no-deps --no-build core [poller=core]' before exit 1, and the note no longer says the live worker colour polls; the same path with HOLD computed by the script recreates Core with core at step 7
findings.mirror_core_to_worker_exit_4: kept by design and documented: Core (held at core) and the kept new colour may both poll; Telegram refuses one of two concurrent getUpdates (409) and intake deduplicates. The note says so
findings.hosts_unknown: fixed. hostsArg maps 'unknown' and any list with an unusable name to null. The reviewer's scratchpad/ops-review-unknown.mts now prints 'exit 4 posts 1' (the registration is sent) instead of exit 2 with 'does not host TaskWorkflow, TaskService'. A transient /ready failure on a current build is still refused while ChatInbox is routed; the reason now says the list may not have been readable
findings.hosts_check_after_step_7: fixed where 4b names the idle colour. deploy.sh image_hosts reads WORKER_SERVICE_NAMES from the built image (docker run --rm --pull never --network none --entrypoint node <image>, apps/worker/dist/services.js); refuse_split_worker_build runs restate-bluegreen.ts check-hosts right after verify_built_image and before step 7. On a stack that was down (no PLAN_IDLE) only register's 7b check applies
findings.restore_database_properties: fixed. The restore-swap block copies owner, grants and scalar settings from the live database to the restored one (infra/backup/restore_copy_props.sql) and swaps only when owner, encoding/locale, grants and settings compare equal (infra/backup/restore_props.sql). Production's datacl and pg_db_role_setting were not read (no SQL against production); the block checks them at restore time
findings.getme_in_worker_mode: not changed in code; documented in infra/docker/README.md and ADR-129 as intended (finding 3). The exit note now says the new colour is registered when step 8 fails after the switch
findings.verification_note: no action; the reviewer's counts agree with this branch's own drills
